zh-CN.title: 荣誉徽章焕新
items: 创始人奖章升级为金色珐琅徽章，名片与领取仪式同步展示
统一年度徽章的年份字体、图案尺寸与文字排版，并将活动徽章更名为探索者徽章

en.title: Refreshed honor medals
items: A new gold and green Founder Medal appears on profiles and in the award ceremony
Annual medals share matching typography, artwork sizes and layouts; the activity medal is now the Explorer Badge
